name: What A Day That Was!
source:
Perry, Tell County, Indiana, USA. Halloween, 2002.

Cade Schafer and his two friends, August Hannegan and Max Foster, are high school seniors– and delinquents– bored on Halloween Night. With no ambition, no direction, and no plans, what else is there to do in the middle of nowhere except continue their annual tradition of going around Perry and causing trouble?

[From [url=https://shiroooo-dev.itch.io/what-a-day-that-was]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
佩里，美国印第安纳州泰尔县。万圣节，2002年。

凯德·谢弗和他的两个朋友奥古斯特·汉尼根和马克斯·福斯特是高中生，也是罪犯，他们在万圣节之夜感到无聊。没有野心、没有方向、没有计划，除了继续他们每年绕着佩里制造麻烦的传统之外，在荒无人烟的地方还能做什么呢？

[来自[url=https://shiroooo-dev.itch.io/what-a-day-that-was]Itch.io[/url]]
